Where Savor wins: Savor does more of the typing for you. Its AI reads the photo and proposes the dish name and tags; Crumble asks you to write the dish. If your bottleneck is effort rather than privacy, that automation is a real advantage and we won't pretend otherwise.

Try Crumble free

## 2. Beli: best if you want ranking instead of rating

Beli attacks the same problem from the opposite end. Instead of asking "how good was this, out of ten," it asks "was this better than the last place?", and each answer sorts your personal list. People who freeze at the difference between a 7 and an 8 often find ranking easier and more honest. [...] Savor got the hardest part right. Most food apps rate the restaurant and stop there, which is useless six months later when you remember you loved something at that place but not what. Savor rates the plate: a 10-point score per dish, AI that reads your photo and suggests the dish name and tags, flavour notes, and a "Time Machine" that lines the same dish up across cities and years.

So if you are searching for apps like Savor, you are usually not looking to give up dish-level detail. You are looking for something that keeps it while changing one other thing: who can see your log, which devices it runs on, or how much of the typing a machine does for you. This guide sorts the six real options by exactly that. [...] ## 1. Crumble: best Savor alternative for a friends-only dish log

Crumble starts from the same premise as Savor (the dish is the unit that matters, not the restaurant) and then makes a different bet about who your log is for. Savor is a private archive you can share out of. Crumble is friends-first: a small circle sees your map by default, and you see theirs.

## What is SavorApp\_AI

Savor is an Intention Layer™ app designed for thoughts that never reach your to-do list. Users can speak, type, or snap a photo to capture an idea as a clear card, organized into Now, Soon, or Later. Reminders bring intentions back when they matter, and cards or individual steps can be handed off to someone you trust with a private chat for context. A Take Action (Beta) mode helps users explore options, build a plan or list, and draft usable wording. Savor is free on iOS and Android.

### SavorApp\_AI

Capture what matters and move your intentions forward

Savor is an Intention Layer for all those thoughts that never quite make it onto your to-do list. You can speak, type, or snap a photo, and Savor creates a clear card organized into Now, Soon, or Later. Reminders bring each thought back when it actually matters. The Take Action (Beta) feature helps you explore your options, build a plan or list, and draft words you can use. You can review and adjust as you go, or hand off a whole card or a single step with a private chat for context. You decide what happens next, and it is free on iOS and Android.
